sv.title: MFF-forwarden som vräker in mål – väntar fortfarande på chansen
sv.summary: Malmö FF:s yttrar har haft svårt att producera poäng de senaste månaderna. I truppen finns dock en 19-årig forward som vräker in mål och assist från sin högerkant. – Det hade varit jättekul att få spela, säger Antonio Palac.

en.title: The MFF forward who scores goals – still waiting for his chance
en.summary: Malmö FF's forwards have struggled to produce points in recent months. However, the squad includes a 19-year-old forward who scores goals and assists from his right wing. – It would have been really fun to get to play, says Antonio Palac.
